stemMd: Which caption would best address the client’s concern?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Neighbouring conditions are irrelevant to daylight

options.label: C
options.textMd: Existing surroundings shown; permitted neighbouring development is assessed separately

options.label: E
options.textMd: Every future detail is shown exactly

explanationMd: The caption identifies the scenario in the image and directs attention to the alternative study. It makes the dependence on existing surroundings explicit without falsely claiming certainty about future construction.

distractorRationale.d: The permission makes such a guarantee unsupported.
distractorRationale.e: The studies are not certain predictions.
distractorRationale.a: The text identifies possible shading effects.
distractorRationale.b: All representations select conditions and inputs.
